title: backlog.json repositories map and an item's repos and repos_if_needed, validated by check and set by set
goal: backlog.json takes a repositories map (name to checkout path under the workspace; absent: the kb's single repository, nothing changes); an item carries repos (required) and repos_if_needed (optional) names from it, which set writes and check validates (an unknown name, a repository in both, an item with touches but no repos while the map is declared)
